semantic_group.pooling_rule: every exact case semantic hash remains an independent stratum; no cross-case objective pooling

profile_records.claim_boundary: Bounded deterministic end-to-end TAAE engineering reconstruction on the declared P3 proxy; original TAAE, Zhangbei arrays, author checkpoint, paper-scale learned state, reported fronts, formal results, and GPU execution remain blocked.

physical_fes_definition: one complete two-objective TAAE proxy layout evaluation; checkpoint construction and training evaluations are excluded

execution.cpu_work_partition: one persistent 20-worker executor partitions independent model forward/cache construction, population encoding, speculative decoding batches, and complete-layout evaluations under ordered deterministic commit

taae_transformer_evolution_declared_reco.generator: bounded deterministic pretraining state plus ten fine-tune epochs per generation using already evaluated population targets
taae_transformer_evolution_declared_reco.seed_source: optimization seed with domain-separated model initialization, pretraining, and fine-tuning event namespaces
taae_transformer_evolution_declared_reco.artifact_hash: record model parameter hash per run; paper-scale checkpoint remains blocked

multiobjective_reporting.reference_front: construct and freeze one empirical feasible nondominated reference set per exact case from the union of all admitted profile-seed fronts; if no feasible front exists, report least-violation fronts separately and do not compute feasible-front HV or IGD+
multiobjective_reporting.normalization: per exact case and per objective using frozen minima and maxima of that case's empirical reference set; zero ranges are recorded and mapped deterministically

resume_policy.atomic_commit: write same-filesystem temporary result, flush and fsync, then rename
